US Operations.heading: US Operations
US Operations.text:
Sales of Obesity care products in US Operations increased by 10% measured in Danish kroner and by 15% at CER to DKK 51,283 million. Sales of Wegovy ® increased by 11% measured in Danish kroner and by 16% at CER to DKK 51,015 million, driven by increased volumes, partially countered by lower realised prices. In the US, Wegovy ® has around 230,000 weekly prescriptions as of 23 January 2026, and the volume growth of the branded obesity market in the US was 108%.

Despite the expiry of the FDA grace period for mass compounding on 22 May 2025, Novo Nordisk market research shows that unsafe and unlawful mass compounding has continued with levels broadly unchanged. In the self-pay channel, NovoCare ® Pharmacy was launched in March 2025. Injectable Wegovy ® prescriptions in the self-pay channel via retail NovoCare ® Pharmacy (including telehealth collaborations) amount to around 70,000 weekly prescriptions as of 23 Ja nuary 2026 . Novo Nordisk continues to invest in expanding direct-to-patient initiatives such as NovoCare ® Pharmacy and further collaborations with telehealth providers initiated during fourth quarter of 2025. Within the insured channel, Novo Nordisk continues to work on expanding access to Wegovy ® in the US .

Sales of Wegovy ® increased by 126% measured in Danish kroner and by 134% at CER to DKK 28,091 million. Wegovy ® has now been launched in more than 50 countries in International Operations. This was partially countered by sales of Saxenda ® in International Operations decreasing by 52% measured in Danish kroner and by 50% at CER to DKK 2,973 million. The volume growth of the branded obesity market in International Operations w as 97%.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Short-term debt and commercial paper
lines.why: Borrowed money: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Lease liabilities
lines.why: IFRS 16 puts every lease on the balance sheet like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Provisions
lines.why: Obligations of uncertain timing or amount (warranties, restructuring, legal claims): operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

intro.text: Novo Nordisk is a leading global healthcare company founded in 1923 and headquartered in Denmark. Our purpose is to drive change to defeat serious chronic diseases built upon our heritage in diabetes. We do so by pioneering scientific breakthroughs, expanding access to our medicines and working to prevent and ultimately cure disease. Novo Nordisk employs abou t 76,300 people in 80 countries and markets its products in around 170 countries. Novo Nordisk's B shares are listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen (Novo-B). Its ADRs are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NVO). For more information, visit novonordisk.com, Facebook, X, LinkedIn and YouTube.
